evals.prompt: Create a new Grade 1 Unit 2 UOI game about community helpers. It should live in src/uoi/, be playable on iPad landscape, include a PYP Map link, and appear in the curriculum hub under the UOI lane.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML file in src/uoi/ with embedded CSS/JS, viewport meta, visible PYP Map return link, 44px+ touch targets, kind feedback, and an updated src/data/curriculum-map.json entry for Grade 1 Unit 2 UOI. The repo QA command should be run or clearly reported if unavailable.

evals.prompt: Adapt the existing spelling bee so Grade 1 Unit 3 can launch a storytelling vocabulary set from the PYP map using a query string. Do not edit the generated homepage by hand.
evals.expected_output: Changes should use src/data/curriculum-map.json for the hub entry, preserve the actual game path, use href for the unit-specific query string, avoid manual edits to src/index.html, and verify with npm run qa:curriculum.

evals.prompt: Build a child-friendly science activity for ages 9-10 that helps students investigate day and night. It should feel like a real game, not a worksheet, and it must work without camera permissions.
evals.expected_output: A browser-playable HTML5 science activity with visual interactive mechanics, no camera dependency, immediate feedback, accessible touch controls, age-appropriate text, PYP Map navigation, curriculum-map registration if it belongs in the hub, and static plus visual verification notes.
